clinical_note: Cross-reaction with cephalosporins is real but lower than historically taught. A severe or anaphylactic penicillin reaction should avoid cephalosporins; a mild rash may not need to.

Includes cotrimoxazole and sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine. Furosemide hydrochlorothiazide and sulfonylureas carry a sulfonamide group but cross-reaction is uncommon — flagged for clinician judgement rather than hard block.
Aspirin ibuprofen and diclofenac cross-react. Paracetamol is safe in NSAID allergy.
Angioedema with an ACE inhibitor should avoid ARBs.
True corticosteroid allergy is rare. Verify before recording.
